units.source_text: 幸好缸里的水新补充到了缸口。

en.t: Fortunately, the water in the jar had just been replenished all the way to the brim.

units.source_text: 他漱了口，洗了脸，像是又活过来了似的。

en.t: He rinsed his mouth and washed his face, and it was as if he had come back to life.

units.source_text: 他还从来没有像现在这样，痛切地感到水的重要。

en.t: Never before had he felt the importance of water so keenly as he did now.

units.source_text: 沙子虽然是矿物质，但它却比任何生物都更能轻易地渗入体内，

en.t: Although sand was a mineral substance, it could seep into the body more easily than any living thing,

units.source_text: 慢慢地流进喉咙深处，他想象着吃石头的野兽……

en.t: As it slowly flowed deep down his throat, he imagined a beast that ate stones...
